# Publish the GitHub profile design

The profile README is ready in [README.md](README.md). Its artwork is hosted in this repository, so no separate image hosting is needed.

## Activate the profile README

1. Create a **public** repository owned by `alexaa1212ss` named exactly `alexaa1212ss`.
2. Copy the contents of [README.md](README.md) into that repository's root `README.md`.
3. Visit [your profile](https://github.com/alexaa1212ss) to see it.

If the profile repository exists but is unavailable to the connected GitHub app, grant the connection access to it so it can be edited.
